title: Cut taglines, helper text and secondary labels in the register, identity, evidence, verify, manage, batches and placeholder screens
layout_fixes: Register index: the header is the Register title and its tabs; the request row and head drop the kind that the title already names
Reject: the tooltip and the two-sentence note became one line, Reject needs a note, shown only while the note is empty
Card verification: the checked time is a Checked row and the signature a Signature row; a revocation reason code sits beside the verdict
Cited page: a revision taken from the register is marked from the register, not the citation, beside the revision itself
Issue card: the 24-hour rule is in the Valid until label and appears as the error only when the expiry is refused
Sources: the file name shows only when it differs from the chip name; the count beside Sources (the Documents tab count) is gone
kept_as_state: Disabled reasons in one short line: Needs a sanctioned plan and an observed survey; Select a unit with a proposed code
Counts with their record state: N reviewed levels from a level schedule; This case holds N retained sources; Rows a to b of n
Server refusals and reading statements where they are the state of the thing; region notes only when the region is not drawn
The deviation exclusions list and the What the sources do not say list stay as the record states them
Draft on this device, not a registry record stays as the draft state of a browser-made code
not_changed_outside_own: app/router.tsx passes PlannedPage a milestone; the placeholder title now carries it, so no prop is dead
portal/RecordPage.tsx passes DraftNotice its own words; DraftNotice keeps the children prop and drops only its default
map/MapWorkspace.tsx passes DeleteDialog its own detail line; the dialog's second help line is cut for both callers
identity/outcome.ts refusal words are shared with intake and review screens; they are joined into one sentence each, and no test outside OWN asserts them
The export builders register/registry.ts, workbook.ts and exporters.ts write files (PDF, workbook, package readme), not screens, and are unchanged
